A [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] '''species''' was little-known throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref><ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> Members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] lacked visible [[Ear/Legends|ears]] and had a flat nose and a ridge on the brow. At least some of them had red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and orange-brown skin. They also had hair that could be brown.<ref name="GG9" /> [[Dharus]], a member of the species, was tall for a humanoid and used technology designed for [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="GG9" />
